scenarios.title: Irregular sleep graduate student
ground_truth_sentences: This graduate student has highly variable sleep timing across the 45-day window.
Weekend sleep is later than weekday sleep and the schedule repeatedly shifts across midnight.
Sleep duration is not uniformly low, so timing irregularity is the primary pattern rather than simple sleep deprivation.
Activity and stress remain secondary signals and should not replace the sleep-timing finding.

expected_findings.description: Detect high day-to-day sleep timing variability.
Detect a later weekend sleep schedule than the weekday schedule.

scenarios.title: Sedentary remote worker
ground_truth_sentences: This remote worker has persistently low daily movement despite otherwise stable measurements.
Steps and active minutes remain well below the balanced-routine scenario for most days.
The pattern is chronic low activity rather than a short acute change point.
The Agent should identify the sustained activity deficit without inventing a medical explanation.

expected_findings.description: Detect sustained low steps and active minutes.

scenarios.title: High stress office worker
ground_truth_sentences: This office worker enters a sustained high-stress period in the middle of the observation window.
Stress rises while mood declines and resting heart rate increases modestly.
Activity falls during the same period, creating a cross-metric pattern that should be discoverable.
The pattern is behavioural and descriptive; it does not establish a diagnosis or causal medical claim.

expected_findings.description: Detect stress increase paired with mood decline.
Detect reduced activity during the high-stress window.

scenarios.title: Return to activity after inactivity
ground_truth_sentences: This user starts from a low-activity baseline and gradually resumes regular movement.
Steps and active minutes rise across the observation window rather than jumping in a single day.
Plan completion improves alongside the gradual activity recovery.
The Agent should recognise improvement while avoiding pressure for an abrupt increase.

expected_findings.description: Detect a sustained upward activity trend.
Detect improving plan completion over time.

scenarios.title: Mild fall risk older adult
ground_truth_sentences: This older adult has moderate activity with lower activity confidence than the other personas.
Two synthetic near-fall events occur during the 45-day period and no fall event is injected.
Activity confidence temporarily decreases around the near-fall days.
The Agent should surface the safety-relevant pattern conservatively without diagnosing a condition.

expected_findings.description: Detect and cite the two near-fall observations.
Detect lower activity confidence around near-fall events.

scenarios.title: Structured missingness user
ground_truth_sentences: This user has otherwise ordinary measurements but contains deliberate non-random data gaps.
Wearable-derived metrics are missing in one contiguous device-non-wear block.
Self-reported stress, mood, and journals are missing in a separate contiguous check-in gap.
The Agent should identify the missingness structure and avoid treating absent values as observed deterioration.

expected_findings.description: Detect the contiguous wearable missingness block.
Detect the separate self-report missingness block.

scenarios.title: Stable metrics with subjective discomfort
ground_truth_sentences: This user's wearable measurements remain stable with little objective trend.
Journal entries repeatedly describe low energy or feeling off despite stable sleep, activity, and heart-rate signals.
The intended signal is an objective-subjective mismatch rather than a hidden physiological trend.
The Agent should acknowledge the reported experience without contradicting it or inventing objective deterioration.

expected_findings.description: Detect stable objective metrics alongside repeated subjective discomfort.

scenarios.title: Low adherence user
ground_truth_sentences: This user has usable health data but progressively lower completion of the proposed routine.
Weekly plan completion ratios decline across the observation window.
Journal entries mention practical barriers rather than a lack of available measurements.
The Agent should detect low adherence and use it as a reason to adapt future actions.

expected_findings.description: Detect recurring routine barriers in journal entries.

scenarios.title: Recovery after disruption
ground_truth_sentences: This user has a stable baseline, followed by a one-week disruption and then recovery.
During the disruption, sleep and activity decrease while stress rises.
After the event window, the affected metrics progressively return toward their earlier baseline.
The Agent should distinguish temporary deterioration from the later recovery trend.

expected_findings.description: Detect the bounded deterioration window across sleep, stress, and activity.
Detect recovery after the disruption window.

scenarios.title: Stable balanced routine
ground_truth_sentences: This user provides a deliberately stable comparison case with regular sleep and activity.
Stress, mood, resting heart rate, and activity confidence fluctuate only within a narrow range.
No meaningful deterioration, recovery event, or structured missingness is injected.
The Agent should recognise stability rather than forcing a problem-oriented interpretation.

expected_findings.description: Detect broadly stable metrics without a material change point.
